correctness.rationale: Exact BVP and independently derived environment-preserving renewal kernel both yield H=1/2 1^T(I-E)(Q+RE)^{-1}1 with positive rates and invertible resolvent. Strict Jensen convexity establishes the slow penalty. A complete low/high eigenspace expansion gives the 1/nu coefficient with O(nu^-2) error at fixed positive parameters. The derivative has exactly one positive root, so opposite strict signs at finite slow and fast switch rates follow by continuity. The supplied program passed 176 deterministic assertions including four separately assembled spatial lattice-generator comparisons; those checks supplement rather than replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The exact influence of environmental refreshing on first passage is a motivated outstanding observable of the 2025 doubly stochastic resetting model. At fixed mean intensity and every nonzero amplitude, slow refresh always worsens search; above a natural optimal-search threshold fast refresh improves it. The sharp threshold and contrasting signs give a falsifiable control implication, not an arbitrary finite tabulation or merely the classical optimal rate.
